items.title: Chemical Teens
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Want to learn more about science? Jump into the skin of one of these chemical teens and represent an element from the periodic table!

+ 12 scientific skins
+ 1 FREE skin: Radium!

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Mobs & Friends!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
The mobs have paired up with their mini friends!
Pick up this pack and have a fun time with your pals!

+ 10 Mobs & Friends skins!
+ 2 free skins!
+ Includes creeper & ocelot, piglin & strider, and many more!

items.title: DREAM TEAM
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
DREAM TEAM! Join the ultimate dream team with these modern teen skins!

+ Great for roleplay, PvP, and PvE

items.title: Skyblock Classic
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
The classic skyblock experience is here! Complete the full Minecraft game in the sky! Can you survive?

+ Explore unique skyblock islands.
+ Open world.
+ A great challenge!

items.title: Royal Blocks
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These royal blocks now have the fanciest crowns in all the land! Rule with an iron fist, or better yet, a diamond fist!

This set comes with 8 skins! 

Includes the following:

- Diamond
- Glass
- Emerald
- Chest
- Gold
- Tree
- Redstone
- Hay Bale

items.title: Arcade Mobs
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Get your game on with these neon, sci-fi retro mobs. 15 crazy colorful skins including fluorescent creepers, ultra violet zombies, electric ravagers, radioactive slime mobs and more!

items.title: The Green Mask
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
The green mask has taken over the city of dreams... But you can be the gamer who saves it! Are you a teenager, a king or a crewmate? You choose which character you want to become!

- 8 green mask skins!
- Perfect for the role-play of your dreams!
- By Pixelusion & SucreGappySan

items.title: Mushroom HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Enjoy your next woodland adventure in this aesthetic mushroom fashion. A variety of forest colors included with cute fungi hats to give off a cottage core feel.

+ 12 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Pink Power HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
If pink is your favorite color, then this skin pack is for you! An aesthetic group of teens dressed in red and pink tones with cute fashionable styles. 

+ 12 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Anime Soccer Stars
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description: Come grab a jersey and get ready for the big game! You and your friends will look like the true teen dream team in these skins! From the playing field to the open field, you will be ready to co-op to the next level!

items.title: Farm Life Survival
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Pigs that you can fly and trucks and tractors that can change colors are all things that come with your new fresh land! Experience the dream lifestyle of a modern day farmer with endless free land to grow crops, drivable vehicles, and skins to match. 

- 6 teen skins
- 2 barns and 9 houses
- Flyable pigs
- Starting loot
